title: Ladder fixture, second book read
tagline: Not a state and never loaded by the application. Holds one name the first book also holds, one name twice under two categories, and one name nothing else holds — the three rungs of the disambiguation ladder, one recipe each.

recipes.name: Bisi Bele Bath
recipes.sub: A hotter one, with more tamarind
recipes.why: Rung 1: the state separates it from the first book's dish of the same name.

method.en: Cook the rice and the dal together, with more tamarind.

recipes.name: Alugadde Palya
recipes.why: Rung 2: a fast-day dish sharing its name with an everyday one in the same book. A cook given the wrong one on a fast day has broken the fast, so the state alone must not be allowed to settle it.

method.en: Boil, peel and temper with cumin in ghee. No mustard.

recipes.name: Alugadde Palya
recipes.why: Rung 2, the other half: same name, same book, a different dish.

method.en: Boil, peel and temper with mustard, curry leaves and asafoetida.

recipes.name: Neer Dose
recipes.why: Rung 0: nothing else is called this, so it is left exactly as the book names it.

method.en: Grind, thin the batter and pour on a hot tawa.
